Ive never tried psychedelics but in college I made a really close friend my freshman year. He got in trouble over the summer because of psychedelics and almost didnt come back. When he did come back we roomed together and while the drugs never affected his school work he had definitely changed. Trust me im not one of those weird people that doesnt like drugs. My friend and I would always drink and smoke, but I just was always a little freaked out by psychedelics. His personality changed and even when he wasn't on them he would always get super philosophical. Which he never used to do, he would make really strange comments about our friends and how he didnt feel welcome, or he felt strange around them. I can honestly say that we were always welcome because it was the same group of friends as the year before and we all got along. When ever he was drunk he would talk about how the psychedelics opened his eyes to a different perspective, and how sometimes he thought he was Jesus, and other weird shit. The next year he never came back to school even though he was a good student. He stopped texting me deleted every social media account he had, I think most people can handle psychedelics in moderation, but I think he just used them too much because he turned into a totally different person. Its been almost 3 years since I have heard from him.
